Messages.Author: James Coupe

In message <4rrlb9F...@mid.individual.net>, Joshua Duffin

<joshdu...@SPAM.gmail.com> writes:
>Perhaps more to the point, are you just teasing us by responding to this
>thread at all (e.g. suggesting contacting the time fairy)? Or is it
>possible that reprint wish lists would actually influence the powers who
>decide on reprints, if submitted far enough in advance? :-)

In as much as a well-considered list of products that people want to buy
would influence a company that wants to make a profit, I can't see that
it hurts.

Dreams, War Ghoul, Direct Intervention, Freak Drive et al have been
reprinted a lot in starters because LSJ knows people want them, so far
as I can tell. Being able to look up a player-compiled list of wanted
cards (for reprinting) in order to sell starters and/or boosters seems
like something that any rational company would, at least, think about.

Of course, it might not gel with their current plans. Like, if the next
few sets are planned around the Sabbat/Black Hand, Anarchs, Indies and
the Laibon[0], requests to reprint Parity Shift, Praxis Seizures and
Second Tradition won't likely be met.

[0] Plucked out of thin air, save for the Sabbat/Black Hand reference to
Sword of Caine.

--
